title: I'm using Muse agents to trade CME futures market
author: CyborgTraderOFTAGI
selftext: I've created a interesting setup designed for this. The agent that trades get's the signal from the trading app I developed for trade plans. The Muse agent just reads the ticket, and executes the trade. Longer term trades, nothing super fast. This isn't HFT, this is slow and steady account building. So far so good. Next up on the list is to create an API connection to broker so the agent no longer has to use the browser to place trades, which is slow and clunky. With API, it's instant, data is instant, trades are instant, alerts are set instant. This is going to get crazy. I'll be making YT videos soon of it all. Follow me to keep up-to-date.
